messages.subject: ACI Calculation & Illustrating calculation process
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to understand the calculation process of the common acoustic indices like the ACI. I tried to visualize the process of the frequency bins and temporal steps used for the calculation. But I'm not sure if I got everything right and if the graphic I generated is right. I want to use it for a project report.

my understanding of the calculation process very briefly would be:
- the spectrogram will be divided into temporal steps (j), and frequency bins (usually 256), for calculating the absolute difference between intensity values of smaller time fractions inside each temporal step and frequency bin
- the ACI value for a recording in total will be a summary of values obtained by comparison of time fractions
- Therefore, longer recordings will generate higher ACI values (For a comparison of different recordings, the same recording duration will be crucial)


I would appreciate every comment and corrections!
Thank you,

Saskia
